title: large, clear lunch case
text: large, clear lunch case. I purchased this to store and move my grandsons' nebulizer.  The case is a lot larger than I expected... but then.. my neb is pretty small.  On the up size it holds all the masks, hoses, meds, cords... It is clear.  It has zippers.  It's pretty thick.  It has a nice long strap to move/hold/handle.  It's bigger than I personally need, but it works!  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
